title: P11.5 authorized policy projection compatibility
goal: Allow the base-owned Validate runner to evaluate the exact authorized legacy-to-canonical Architecture command declaration during the P11.5 two-version window without trusting head implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: The bridge activates only for the complete four-entry legacy-to-canonical command substitution in required-checks.json.
The exact head must consume both named P11.5 preparation authorizations under the base protected-change verifier before candidate policy is projected.
Only the authorized declaration is copied into the disposable candidate package and base-owned rendering and verification continue to decide the verdict.
All other candidate-policy shapes remain base-owned and fail closed under the existing contract.
